justification: User-facing wording on the public flood tool (36 runs in the last 30 days, PostHog 2026-11-04). Frontend only: no backend, no DB, no new data. Not Minor because the old row read as a clear flood result where none was checked.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Mutation 1 (overlay branch condition made unreachable): 1 failed / 19 passed. Mutation 2 (flood_map_reason row disabled): 1 failed / 19 passed. Clean: 20 passed.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Live production response of POST canibuildit.com.au/api/satellite/flood for 260 Blende Street Broken Hill, 2026-11-04: epi_flood_class 'none', ses_in_flood_planning_area null, flood_map_reason "we do not hold this council's flood planning map ...". The fixture copies that response.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Measured on this branch 2026-11-04 by sed: overlay branch disabled -> 1 failed / 19 passed ('never shows a green Not mapped as flood-prone row'); reason row disabled -> 1 failed / 19 passed ('shows why, and where the council's own studies are'). Restored: 20 passed.

pre_impl.existing_data: No table touched. Reads outputs.flood_map_reason, already returned by services/flood_truth.py (from services/flood_planning.py, #1539) but never rendered by the tool.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: ses_in_flood_planning_area is three-state. Only false means we hold the council map and the lot is off it; null (not held, near the edge, unknown council, check failed) now gets the amber row. Older cached results without flood_map_reason simply show no council-map row.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Applies to every render, including cached results.

functions.name: FloodCard
functions.input: result.outputs JSON from POST /api/satellite/flood, cast to FloodResult
functions.output: findings rows rendered in the flood result card
functions.if_none: flood_map_reason missing or blank -> no council-map row; overlay row stays amber unless ses_in_flood_planning_area === false

break_it.scenario: Council map held, lot clear (ses false) but the overlay row turns amber anyway, hiding a real negative.
break_it.what_happens: User loses a real 'not on the map' result.
break_it.how: Branch only fires when ses_in_flood_planning_area !== false; test 'still shows the clear overlay row where we hold the map' covers it.

break_it.scenario: Elevated or moderate signal with overlay none and map not held.
break_it.what_happens: Existing amber 'Not in statutory flood overlay' row must still win.
break_it.how: New branch placed after the moderate/elevated branch.

break_it.scenario: Backend reason text is lower-case and contains a raw URL, so it reads oddly or the link is not clickable.
break_it.what_happens: User sees a plain-text URL to the council's studies; still readable and correct.
break_it.how: First letter capitalised; URL left as text on purpose (no new link component). Test checks the URL text is shown.

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes: run the live tool on 260 Blende Street Broken Hill and confirm the two amber rows.
